parkinson_diagnosis.description: Patients with a diagnosis of Parkinson disease.

items.rationale: The concept 'Parkinson's disease' (381270) is the most specific and relevant to the clinical description of Parkinson disease. Including descendants will capture related conditions and manifestations.
The concept 'Vascular parkinsonism' (4046093) is included as it is a specific type of Parkinsonism that should be captured in the cohort.
